intent: A licensing hold stops a run that was already queued, not only new ones.
observable_outcome: get-context run lists the new rule as reviewed, proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A run of a skill under an access restriction is refused when it is created, and a run that was queued before the restriction was set fails as policy_refused at dispatch, before any sandbox receives the package; while the restriction cannot be read the run stays queued.
